item.description:
Draft keeps your words pointed the way you said them. An instruction stays an instruction, a question stays a question, and Draft never answers or invents a figure on your behalf — it writes for the reader, it doesn't reply as the reader.

Spoken shorthand is written out reliably. "gonna" and "wanna" now become "going to" and "want to" every time, instead of occasionally slipping through. Clean gets the same fix.
